description: sorry-matt guards: ask before releases, production deploys, Claude Code settings writes and merges that deploy, and confirm catastrophic deletes, outgoing messages and payments twice; at every session start, hand the agent the one line that enters unattended mode; when a permission dialog goes unanswered for SORRY_MATT_UNATTENDED_AFTER minutes (default 10), take it back and enter unattended mode, and while unattended deny every permission dialog and every AskUserQuestion at once; when the user sends a message in any session, end the automatic unattended state and hand the agent the list of what was blocked meanwhile; when the user types /sorry-matt:unattended on, off or status, flip or show the user's own switch (off only on a turn the user sent) and hand the agent the result; while a run is in progress, count its host session's subagents and deny that session a spawn past the ledger's spawn limit; after a compaction, point an in-progress run back at its ledger and rule files
